include_rule: Recursively mirror every entry under the task root; one exact top-level exclusion old-features/ only. Future new files are included automatically, not selected by an allowlist.
required_if_produced: final reports/evaluation/plots exported into task root
all candidate best.npz and last.pt with training history
partial recovery files if execution stops incomplete

coverage_notes.data: Includes full new source articles, complete input JSONL, fixed50 payload, final semantic audit, both scale manifests and quality exclusions; private only.
coverage_notes.features: All new FIT/DEV/TEST feature shards, metadata, commit receipts and pilot features; no current growing cache is copied now.
coverage_notes.run: All three candidate checkpoints, optimizer/resume state, training and best-epoch histories, frozen final probe, validation and TEST arrays/results.
coverage_notes.logs_and_runtime: All phase logs, driver/watchdog identity, resource CSV, absolute/monotonic budget and stage receipts, setup environment pins and weight verification.
coverage_notes.cache: Inside-task caches and symlinks included; links preserved without dereferencing paths outside the source tree.

retained_dependencies.requirement: Keep the original immutable local cache and sealed implementation; no need to send it to RunPod or duplicate it as a new remote payload.

local_new_outputs.requirement: Archive the final local experiment output tree and any private new AgentDojo probability arrays once complete, alongside the task mirror; these may never have existed remotely.

quiescence_gate: Driver and CUDA workers terminal by PID/start identity; a zombie state is terminal, not an active worker.
Resource monitor and watchdog finish their final writes; no local or remote exporter is still mutating files to be inventoried.
Source files are inventoried only after the final outputs are exported. If source changes during transfer, refresh affected entries and reverify.
safety_of_transfer: No --delete, no remote deletion or power operation, no following external symlink targets, no Git publication of the private mirror.
acceptance_sequence: Record exact source inventory with type, size, mode, mtime_ns, link target and independent SHA256 of every included regular file.
Run transfer, preserve exit status and full transfer log, and reconcile complete inventory rather than only checking command exit.
Hash every local mirrored regular file and compare to the independent source inventory; verify every symlink target and reject unexplained extra/missing files.
Verify produced feature shard commits, checkpoint/freeze identities and recorded metadata manifests as additional semantic checks.
Recheck source type/size/mtime/link stability after copy; any mutation invalidates the affected entry until refreshed.
Verify retained dependency manifests/proofs still match the recorded hashes; report dependency-based completeness explicitly.
Write local SHA256SUMS, source/local manifests, integrity report, coverage report and backup README; flush writes before declaring backup verified.
current_action: Planning/inventory only; active feature extraction and new model scores were not copied or inspected.
